def: to take the right hand road
kjv: turn to the right. See H539 (אָמַן).

words.word: when ye turn to the right hand

occurrences.text: And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way, walk ye in it, when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.
